description: Deterministic edit: set registry properties on one existing layer of a project, committed immediately (no planner, no export). E.g. {"x": 540, "y": 960}, {"scale": 1.2}, {"opacity": 0.5}, {"volume": 0.3}, {"visible": false}, {"z_index": 4}, or its timeline window {"start_time": 2, "end_time": 8}. Unknown keys are ignored, and an update that changes nothing is an error (NO_CHANGE). Not for keyframed animation (use autonomous_edit), and not "text" on a caption group (refused: it would overwrite every caption). Get layer ids from get_project (project.scene.layers[].id).

layer_id.description: Id of the layer to change.

project_id.description: Project whose committed scene is edited.

name: update_layer
title: Update layer
